text:
lina: Heads up 1: vendor just sent notice: partial release on April allocation. AWB and RMA details below.
rob: drop AWB and which SKUs are shipping partial?
lina: AWB: 2Z555BB98765432100. Partial release = 5x H100-80GB (air), 3x H100-80GB (ground hold EU), 4x H200s (held, commercial invoice issues).
marc (vendor): "Confirm partial release. We can air-accelerate 5 H100s for EUR 8,250 uplift total. Remaining H100s are at customs pending HS code clarification; ground ETA +12 business days. Revised commercial invoice will be uploaded."
ashwin: uplift math -> EUR 8,250 / 5 = EUR 1,650 per GPU. Do we have spare pool to cover client SLAs if we wait?
sara: spare pool = 3x H100 at CDG depot (reserved). Not enough for top-2 accounts.
rob: options: 1) pay uplift and crossdock to CDG; 2) rotate H200s for non-critical workloads; 3) notify affected customers and schedule degraded capacity.
lina: also vendor says 2 H200s flagged with wrong HS code. If they reissue invoice that may free the rest in 3-5 days.
marc (vendor): "Uploading corrected invoice and serial manifest by EOD UTC. Will include unit photos and packing list."
ops-bot: "RMA created: RMA-99210 | Vendor: VectorShip | AWB: 2Z555BB98765432100 | Partial: 5 H100, 4 H200 | Status: pending-internal-approval"
ashwin: I can approve up to EUR 12k from regional ops discretionary. That covers EUR 8,250 uplift. Need vendor invoice and PO amendment.
rob: please tag GL code INF-GPU-EXP if approved. Finance to confirm later.
sara: depot checklist if air lands:

```
RECEIVING CHECKLIST
- AWB: 2Z555BB98765432100
- Units expected: 5x H100-80GB
- Vendor manifest: required (serial list)
- Photos: pallet, labels, box interior
- QA window: 3 hours from truck arrival
- Escalate to @rob if serial mismatches >1
```

lina: vendor confirmed they'll provide reinforced packaging and extra photos.
marc (vendor): "We'll include foam reinforcements and ship packing photos. Manifest & invoice will be in portal by 1830 UTC."
rob: consensus to proceed with air-express for the 5 H100s. ashwin to approve once invoice lands. sara prepare depot for expedited QA and crossdock to CDG reserve.
ashwin: approved in principle at 3665001500; will finalize after receiving vendor invoice. Please cc finance and include PO amendment number.
lina: customer comms: I'll draft short note to the top-2 impacted accounts explaining priority uplift and expected arrival window; will include rollback plan.
sara: one request 1 1 can vendor include a spare foam insert per unit? previous air batch had one unit with corner crush.
marc (vendor): "Will include spare foam inserts and additional photo evidence. Tracking updates will be posted."
ops-bot: "RMA-99210 status updated to approved-expedite by ashwin at 3665001500."
rob: thanks everyone. closing tasks: RMA-99210 -> ops, invoice -> ashwin, depot prep -> sara, PO amendment -> lina. Any objections? :thumbsup:
ashwin: :thumbsup:
sara: :thumbsup:
marc (vendor): Thanks, will keep thread live with AWB tracking and manifest upload.
